lines.text: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron, his sons and the elders, and told them the LORD would appear that day.
Aaron slaughtered the calf as his sin offering and burned its flesh and hide on the altar's base.
Aaron's sons brought him the burnt offering's blood, and he splattered it on all sides of the altar.
Aaron burned the fat portions on the altar, but he burned the breasts and the right thigh outside the camp.

wrong_details.wrong: burned the breasts and the right thigh outside the camp
wrong_details.true: waved the breasts and the right thigh as a wave offering before the LORD

lines.text: Fire from the LORD consumed the burnt offering and fat portions, and the people shouted for joy and fell facedown.
